description: Update Sequence Status - Start, pause, stop, or archive a sequence. Recipients must be the account holder's own contactable audience. Blocklist and unsubscribe suppression is always enforced. Setting status to ACTIVE starts sending emails to recipients, so it needs the user's approval: the client asks the user directly, or the tool returns a preview and a login link where the user starts the sequence in the SalesBlink app.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: update_sequence_status

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.
